name: Re:amaze
oneLiner: Helpdesk and AI customer service platform for ecommerce and online businesses, with a shared inbox, live chat, bots and multi-brand support (sold as Re:amaze by GoDaddy).
bestFor: Online stores and brands, including food and beverage brands selling online, that run one or several storefronts on Shopify or BigCommerce.

updates.text: Intents, which sort incoming messages, now run on AI and need no extra training data.
The AI context used for generated replies and FAQs now also powers response templates, quick replies, appointment and shopper bots, suggested responses and the AI FAQ bot.

features: Shared inbox for email, live chat, social media, SMS, VoIP and video calls
AI Agent (beta) trained on your help content, extended from chat to email and SMS
Order details from Shopify and BigCommerce (and payments from Stripe) inside conversations
Chatbots and Cues (proactive, trigger-based chat messages)
Multiple brands with separate inboxes, help centers and branding in one account (Pro and Plus)
AI-powered Intents for sorting messages, plus AI-suggested FAQs, conversation summaries and sentiment analysis

pricing.text: Per team member per month, billed monthly: Basic $29 (1 brand, 5 AI resolutions per user per month), Pro $49 (unlimited brands, 10 AI resolutions) and Plus $69 (unlimited brands, 20 AI resolutions); annual billing lowers these to $26.10, $44.10 and $62.10. Starter is $59 per month flat for unlimited team members and up to 500 responded conversations a month. 14-day free trial with all Plus features, no credit card; no free plan.

notes: reamaze.com could not be fetched; prices come from a May 2026 snapshot of the pricing page quoted in third-party guides and should be confirmed on reamaze.com/pricing. Built Bar and Todd Snyder appear as testimonials on Shopify's Re:amaze partner page; the Built Bar '5.6x faster' figure comes only from a third-party listing and was not used. Original's '$29/month for 3 team members' was replaced (pricing is now per user). The AI Agent email/SMS expansion appears to be from 2026 but I couldn't confirm the month, so it isn't dated. 2026-11: reamaze.com/pricing, the homepage and /integrations fetched directly; prices confirmed. WooCommerce isn't on the integrations page (Shopify, BigCommerce, Stripe, WordPress are), so it was dropped. The homepage no longer mentions GoDaddy, but GoDaddy's Re:amaze help center (reamaze.godaddy.com) confirms the acquisition. G2 rating from a g2.com search snippet (4.6 from 140 reviews).
pros: One inbox for email, live chat, social, SMS, voice and video
Shopify and BigCommerce order details shown inside each conversation
Several brands, each with its own inbox and help center, under one login (Pro and Plus)
Published prices, including a flat-rate Starter plan with unlimited team members
14-day free trial of the Plus features, no credit card

cons.text: The AI Agent is still labeled beta
AI resolutions are capped per user per month: 5 on Basic, 10 on Pro, 20 on Plus
Basic covers one brand; multi-brand support needs Pro or Plus
Starter is capped at 500 responded conversations a month
Built for ecommerce and online businesses, so its listed integrations center on online stores and a restaurant group may need another tool for POS or reservation data

plans.trial: 14-day free trial with all Plus features, no credit card
plans.billing: per team member per month, billed monthly; annual billing discounted
